name: OpenForge AI
mission: Research reliable image-grounded reasoning agents with evidence-based verification.
status: Local evaluator, optional adapter, synthetic pixel verification, saved-run reports/comparisons, source receipts and workflow are implemented on dependent draft branches. Independent review and a real model pilot remain pending.
architecture: core/model_adapters and multimodal: optional pinned VLM adapter and original synthetic visual fixtures
core/reasoning: structured planning and intermediate validation
core/verification: implemented narrow pixel-based claim checks and retained evidence
apps API/worker/dashboard and research reports added when functional
functional_requirements: Report correctness, coverage, abstentions and confidence scoring
Track image/evidence provenance and tool traces
Compare strategies under matched budgets and report failures

backlog.title: Offline evaluation and abstention accounting
backlog.problem: A baseline must account for every task before model comparisons.
backlog.implementation: Strict bounded JSONL references/predictions; exact ID join; exact-string metrics and byte hashes.
acceptance: Conditional metrics are null for full abstention
CLI outputs no partial report on invalid input
tests: Metric accounting, provenance, malformed input and real CLI
backlog.status: Implemented on foundation and dependent draft branches; independent review pending.

backlog.title: Versioned experiment manifest validation
backlog.problem: Metrics alone cannot establish which model/data/config produced predictions.
backlog.implementation: Schema binding input hashes to immutable model/data revisions, licenses, prompt, seed, hardware/software, generation config and git revision.
tests: Missing fields, invalid revisions and hash mismatch
backlog.status: Implemented versioned manifest validation; declaration validity does not authenticate model execution.

backlog.title: Licensed VLM baseline with recorded resource pilot
backlog.problem: Need a real multimodal baseline before verifier comparisons.
backlog.implementation: Compare current model cards/licenses, measure one candidate on available CPU; request GPU budget only if needed.
acceptance: No remote model code enabled by default
Actual predictions and complete manifest preserved
tests: Adapter input errors, oversized images, timeout and inference smoke
backlog.status: Optional pinned candidate adapter and free notebook workflow implemented; actual model inference and cloud runtime validation not recorded.

backlog.title: Descriptive confidence and selective-risk diagnostics
backlog.problem: Declared confidence needs explicit bin/threshold accounting without hiding abstentions or breaking ties favorably.
backlog.implementation: Fixed-width reliability bins with answered-conditional ECE; whole-confidence-tie selective risk-coverage steps.
acceptance: Null empty-bin metrics and all-abstain ECE
No model or statistical result claimed
backlog.status: Implementation and tests in current dependent branch; review pending.

testing_strategy: Strict evaluator unit and CLI integration tests
Adapter contract tests plus explicitly labeled fixtures
Hardware tests optional; no fabricated model execution
Paired controlled experiments with fixed split and uncertainty reporting
release_criteria: Actual VLM baseline and pinned data available
Equal governance and genuine review documented
